welcome.tagline: Plan, log and track your hypertrophy and powerlifting training.

highlights.log: Log every set in two taps

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to log your workouts.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Start logging your workouts in seconds.
register.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If there's an account with that email, a link is on its way. Open it to choose your new password, then sign in here.

preferences.title: Before we start
preferences.subtitle: Pick your language and how to show weights and measurements. You can change it anytime.

body.title: About your body
body.subtitle: Optional. Used by the calorie calculator and to track your progress.

goal.title: What's your goal?
goal.subtitle: Ranks exercises by what you're after.

rest.title: Rest between sets
rest.subtitle: The timer starts with this. You can tweak it per exercise.

today.title: Today
today.emptyMessage: Once you activate a program, today's workout shows up here.

train.title: Train
train.emptyMessage: Create routines on the web and they show up here, offline too. Pull down to sync.

history.title: History
history.emptyMessage: Your logged workouts will show up here.

progress.title: Progress
progress.emptyMessage: Per-exercise charts, weekly volume and personal records.
progress.window: Your plan shows stats for the last {days} days.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.description: Less than a year of consistent training.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.description: 1–3 years; solid technique on the big lifts.

powerlifting.title: Powerlifting
powerlifting.description: Raise your squat, bench and deadlift.

logoutConfirm.title: Sign out?
logoutConfirm.message: Data stored on this device will be deleted. Your synced data stays in your account.
logoutConfirm.unsynced: You have {count} unsynced changes. Signing out now deletes them for good. Go online and wait for them to sync first.

cta.featureMessage: {feature} is part of the Premium plan.

sheet.title: Plans
sheet.manual: For now plan changes are handled by an administrator. In-app subscriptions are coming soon.

verification.banner: Confirm your email ({email}) with the link we sent you.
verification.sent: We sent a new email to {email}.
verification.pending: Not confirmed yet. Check your inbox or spam folder.

session.offline: Offline: you're using the data stored on this device.

waking.title: Waking up the server…
waking.message: The first connection can take up to a minute.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The server took too long to respond. Try again.

sync.title: Sync

status.offline: Offline. Your data is saved on this device.
status.offlinePending: Offline: {count} changes will upload when you are back online.
status.error: Some changes could not be synced

sync.failedHelp: The server did not accept these changes. Retry them, or discard them to get the server version back.

discard.title: Discard the change?
discard.message: This device's version is lost and the server's version (if any) comes back.
